citations.claim: Body 0 is exactly at the final waypoint (17.1,7.9) with near-zero velocity one step before failure
Same step y equals waypoint y, confirming zero distance-to-target
First violating step: body 0 position becomes non-finite (NaN)

counterfactual.change: Moved final waypoint x from 17.1 to 17.5 (0.4 away) so distance-to-target never hits exactly zero; otherwise identical. Failure disappears.

explanation: Controller-driven body 0 converges exactly onto its final waypoint (17.1,7.9) by step 2909 with ~1e-14 velocity. On the next step its position/velocity become non-finite. The pattern indicates the waypoint-seeking law normalizes by distance-to-target (or commanded-direction) without a zero-distance guard, so exact arrival yields 0/0 = NaN which propagates into force, velocity and position.
vision_note: Steps 2907 to 2909 show a stable scene with a red circle holding position in the upper right and two blue circles near the bottom. At step 2910 the red circle vanishes completely while the remaining scene shifts.
